rationale.en: The Analyst estimates an increased state cost of $500 million to $600 million a year for about 20 years to repay the bond. The Analyst adds that the state "could" recover part or all of that cost in later decades if funded research produces discoveries that generate revenue, and that the amount of revenue is uncertain. The measure directs 10 percent of licensing royalties to the General Fund until the bonds are repaid. A net cost of zero is a possible outcome, not an estimated one.
